purpose: Define the minimum verified IR required by the Stage1 general emitter without source rereading or code-generation delegation.

capacity_preflight.reason: The current canonical self-source already reaches 1460 aggregate events/instructions, equal to the four 365-entry event banks. Adding codegen-complete IR logic changes the compiler source itself, so capacity must be expanded or compacted before new logic can be qualified.
rules: Do not truncate any event, value, call, argument, parameter, local, block, instruction, or terminator lane.
Do not select a large arbitrary capacity. Record the pre-change count, the structural delta, selected bounded capacity, and post-change native count.
Every capacity remains fail-closed and verifier checked.
The call-argument pool closure remains 746 unless a measured post-change source proves a new requirement.

identity_rules.local_ids: stable deterministic declaration order within owner function
identity_rules.value_ids: single non-colliding namespace for parameters, locals/constants/results used by instructions and terminators

required_def_use: A parameter reference resolves to its parameter value ID.
A local read resolves to the current local value/storage identity required by bootstrap lowering.
A store records destination local identity and source value ID.
Arithmetic and comparison instructions record operand value IDs and result value ID.
Calls record ordered argument value IDs and a result value ID when the result is consumed.
Discard preserves the identity of its side-effecting instruction instead of erasing it.
Conditional terminators record the condition value ID and both verified targets.
Return terminators record the returned value ID rather than only an aggregate/literal lane.

emitter_boundary.unsupported_shape_behavior: fail closed with a specific emitter diagnostic

verifier_minimum: all parameter/local owners exist and match function ranges
each instruction belongs to exactly one valid block/function
all operand/result value IDs are defined and owned compatibly
call argument ranges are within the bounded 3-bank pool
call result IDs are valid when present
terminator condition/return IDs are valid when required
all branch targets are valid blocks owned by the same function
no silent overflow or truncation in any bank
